## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Scope

This BRD covers the iCollect-side implementation to identify and display the **parent loan application** of a contract that is distributed in iCollect. Field Collectors (FCs) currently face incidents where a contract shows images of a different customer, or no image at all, which hinders customer identity verification during the collection process. The root cause is that iCollect references the related appID directly rather than the **parent appID**. This change enhances the iCollect data pipeline to carry the `ParentLoanAppID` from the core data source and to surface it on the Contract Details screen so FCs can reference the correct parent application.

This BRD governs **STEP 2 — the new data flow** for all contracts going forward. The `ParentLoanAppID` is sourced from the already UAT-approved and released work by the DBA and EDB teams (refer to Dependencies). The one-time historical data patching is tracked as **STEP 1** and its cut-off date is **[TBD — mutually agreed later]**.

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| System | iCollect Mobile App |
| Impacted Systems | Pega ULOS, EDW, ODS, DBAccount (cifdbv2), ECM |
| Product Lines | All (contracts distributed in iCollect) |

### 1.2 Out of Scope

- The rule / logic / integration to display data on the current iCollect Contract Details screen remains **unchanged** and keeps its current behavior.
- The rule / logic / data / integration between **ECM and iCollect** remains **unchanged** and keeps its current behavior.
- The upstream parsing and storage of `ParentLoanAppID` into `ULOS APPLICATION DIM` (DBA) and `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` (EDB) is handled by the dependency tickets DBA-2525 and CRP-7025 — not re-implemented here.
- BLOS-sourced contracts are handled under a separate ticket scope.
- STEP 1 historical data patching logic (one-time migration) is a separate workstream; this BRD states its dependency but the detailed migration approach is **[TBD]**.
- What is not described in this document should be considered out of scope.

## 2. Business Requirement

**As-is:**
- The iCollect database does not carry `ParentLoanAppID` data.
- iCollect displays all images associated with the **related appID** directly, which can show a different customer's images or none at all.
- The iCollect Mobile App Contract Details screen does not present any `ParentLoanAppID` data.

**To-be:**
1. Enhance the iCollect ETL process to additionally fetch `ParentLoanAppID` from the core data source `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` and store it in the iCollect database.
2. Display the `ParentLoanAppID` on the iCollect Mobile App Contract Details screen as a new labelled section — only when the current application has a parent — while keeping all existing display logic and the ECM integration unchanged.

### 2.1 High Level Process Map

The `ParentLoanAppID` originates from the Pega ULOS application message, is parsed and stored by DBA, exposed by EDB into the CIF database, then pulled into iCollect by its ETL job and finally presented on the Contract Details screen.

![High Level Process Map](data:image/png;base64,)

> **Data lineage (committed across dependency tickets):**
> Pega ULOS (`UnifiedApplicationUpdatedMessage` XML) → DBA parses `ParentLoanAppID` into `ULOS APPLICATION DIM` (DBA-2525) → EDB ETL into `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST.PARENT_LOAN_APPID` (CRP-7025, UAT Done) → iCollect ETL into `crm.cstb_contact_app` → iCollect Mobile App Contract Details screen (this BRD).

The cross-system in/out sequence (STEP 2 — new data flow) is shown below.

![Parent App ID — Cross-System Sequence](data:image/png;base64,)

### 2.2 List of User Stories / Use Cases

| # | Story / Use Case / Epic | Priority | Source Ticket |
|---|-------------------------|----------|---------------|
| 1 | Populate a new field `ParentLoanAppID` from the CIF database (`DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST`) to store in the iCollect database | MUST HAVE | ICL2-1762 |
| 2 | The iCollect Mobile App displays the `ParentLoanAppID` data on the Contract Details screen | MUST HAVE | ICL2-1762 |

### 2.3 User Stories / Use Cases / Epic

---

#### Story #1 | Populate a new field `ParentLoanAppID` from the CIF database to store in the iCollect database

> **As a** Collection business user, **I want** iCollect to obtain the `ParentLoanAppID` of each contract from the CIF database and store it in the iCollect database, **so that** the parent application of a contract can be identified and used by downstream iCollect features.

**Acceptance Criteria**

**AC #1 — Enhance the ETL to fetch `ParentLoanAppID` from `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST`**

Enhance the existing iCollect ETL job (its usual process) so that it additionally retrieves the `ParentLoanAppID` data from the core data source `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST`.

**Data Mapping Table**

| No | Source: DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST | Target: iCollect staging (via ETL) | Type | Default Value | Length | Description | Remarks |
|----|-------------------------------|------------------------------------|------|---------------|--------|-------------|---------|
| 1 | `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` | `ParentLoanAppID` | String | " " | [TBD — per current standard] | The parent loan application ID of the current application | Fetched by ETL (usual process, enhanced to pull this field) |

> **In which:**
> - The `ParentLoanAppID` data is made available (if any) in `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` by the DBA and EDB teams — refer to Dependencies and Section 4.
> - `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` holds **only active contracts** at daily processing time. If an application is no longer active, it is not present in this table and its `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` cannot be looked up. Contracts shown in iCollect are active, so this constraint is acceptable (confirmed in CRP-7025).
> - The ETL retrieval follows the **usual process**, enhanced only to additionally obtain the `ParentLoanAppID` data.

**AC #2 — Populate `ParentLoanAppID` into the iCollect database**

Populate the retrieved `ParentLoanAppID` and store it in the iCollect database under `crm.cstb_contact_app`, following the usual logic and process.

**Data Mapping Table**

| No | Source: iCollect staging | Target: iCollect DB | Type | Default Value | Length | Description | Remarks |
|----|--------------------------|---------------------|------|---------------|--------|-------------|---------|
| 1 | `ParentLoanAppID` | `crm.cstb_contact_app.[ParentLoanAppID column]` | String | " " | [TBD — per current standard] | Stored parent loan application ID for the contact/application | Populated as the usual logic and process |

> **In which:**
> - Storage into `crm.cstb_contact_app` follows the existing iCollect logic and process; the column name/type/length follow the current iCollect data standard — **[TBD — confirm exact column definition with iCollect DEV]**.
> - When the source provides no `ParentLoanAppID` for an application (e.g. the application has no parent, or the record is not available in `BOD_CA_CUST`), the field is stored empty — refer to Story #2 for display behavior.

---

#### Story #2 | The iCollect Mobile App displays the `ParentLoanAppID` on the Contract Details screen

> **As a** Field Collector (FC), **I want** the iCollect Mobile App to display the `ParentLoanAppID` on the Contract Details screen, **so that** I can reference the correct parent application of the contract I am collecting.

**Acceptance Criteria**

**AC #1 — DISPLAY PARENT APP ID ON CONTRACT DETAILS SCREEN**

**GIVEN:** I am a Field Collector using the iCollect Mobile App and I open a contract on the Contract Details screen.

**WHEN:** The system renders the Contract Details screen for the current application (refer to Story #1 for the stored `ParentLoanAppID`).

**THEN:** the system presents the Contract Details screen according to the business scenarios below, keeping all existing display logic and behavior unchanged.

**UI MOCK UP:**

- Path: `[Screen]Contract Details`
- Current UI reference (as-is): Jira attachment `image-20261014-084446.png` on ICL2-1762.

![Contract Details screen — Parent App ID](data:image/png;base64,)

**BUSINESS RULE — Display behavior:**

| Business Scenario | iCollect Mobile App / Contract Details screen next action |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| The current application does **not** have its `ParentLoanAppID` | Keep as-is — no new section is shown; existing screen and data remain unchanged |
| The current application **has** its `ParentLoanAppID` | Show a new `ParentLoanAppID` data section on the current UI with the proper label **`Parent App ID <Number>`**; all data underneath remains unchanged |

> **In which:**
> - The rule / logic / integration to display data on the current Contract Details screen remains **unchanged**.
> - The rule / logic / data / integration between **ECM and iCollect** remains **unchanged** and keeps its current behavior.
> - `<Number>` is the stored `ParentLoanAppID` value from Story #1.

**UI Field → System Field Mapping**

| No | Field on the UI | iCollect Field | Presented Value | Path |
|----|-----------------|----------------|-----------------|------|
| 1 | `Parent App ID <Number>` | `crm.cstb_contact_app.[ParentLoanAppID column]` | Refer to Story #1 (stored `ParentLoanAppID`) | `[Screen]Contract Details >> [Section]Parent App ID` |

## 3. Non-Functional Requirements

| Category | Requirement | Details |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| Performance | ETL within existing batch window | The enhanced ETL to fetch `ParentLoanAppID` must run within the current iCollect ETL batch window; no additional real-time call introduced. |
| Security | No new sensitive data exposure | `ParentLoanAppID` is an application identifier; follow existing iCollect data handling and access controls. |
| Scalability / Sizing | No material increase | One additional string field per contact record; negligible storage impact. |
| Availability | Follow current SLA | iCollect data availability follows the current ETL/process SLA; dependent on `BOD_CA_CUST` being populated by DBA/EDB. |

> If further non-functional requirements are identified, they will be confirmed with the technical team.

## 4. High-Level Description for Integration

### 4.1 List of Integration Points

| # | Story / Use Case | Integration Purpose | Input | Output — Logic to fetch data |
|---|------------------|---------------------|-------|------------------------------|
| 1 | Story #1 | iCollect ETL fetches `ParentLoanAppID` from CIF DB | Active contract records in `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` | `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` per active application; retrieved via the usual ETL job (enhanced to pull this field), then stored into `crm.cstb_contact_app` |

> **Upstream lineage (handled by dependency tickets, for context):**
> - Pega ULOS emits `UnifiedApplicationUpdatedMessage`. AppID = `/UnifiedApplicationUpdatedMessage/LoanProcessing/General/AppID`; Parent AppID = `/ns1:UnifiedApplicationUpdatedMessage/ns1:LoanProcessing/ns1:PreOriginationDetails/ns1:EligibleBase/ns1:ParentLoanAppID`.
> - DBA parses `ParentLoanAppID` into `ULOS APPLICATION DIM` (DBA-2525).
> - EDB ETL loads it into `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST.PARENT_LOAN_APPID` (CRP-7025, UAT Done).

### 4.2 DB and Relevant Information

| # | DB Name / Service | Variables | TNS Information / Endpoint / Authentication |
|---|-------------------|-----------|---------------------------------------------|
| 1 | `DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST` (CIF DB / cifdbv2) | `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` (source) | [TBD — per current iCollect ETL connection to CIF DB] |
| 2 | iCollect DB — `crm.cstb_contact_app` | `ParentLoanAppID` (target column) | iCollect internal DB; follows existing ETL process |
| 3 | `ULOS APPLICATION DIM` (DBA) | `ParentLoanAppID` (upstream) | Owned by DBA (DBA-2525) — context only |

### 4.3 Error Handling

| # | Scenario | Behavior | Action / Description |
|---|----------|----------|----------------------|
| 1 | Application has no parent / `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` empty | Store empty; display keeps as-is | No new UI section shown (refer to Story #2 business rule) |
| 2 | Application not active (not present in `BOD_CA_CUST`) | No lookup possible | Accepted limitation — iCollect only shows active contracts (confirmed CRP-7025) |
| 3 | ETL job failure | Follow current ETL error handling | No change to existing ETL error/retry behavior — **[TBD — confirm current ETL error policy]** |

## 6. Glossary

| Key Word | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| iCollect | FE Credit collection mobile app / platform used by Field Collectors |
| FC | Field Collector — collection staff using iCollect |
| ParentLoanAppID / Parent App ID | The loan application ID of the parent (original) application from which the current application derives |
| AppID | Loan application identifier |
| Pega ULOS | Unified Loan Origination System (Pega) — source of the application message |
| DBA | Database Administration team / layer parsing the ULOS message into `ULOS APPLICATION DIM` |
| EDB / EDW | Enterprise Data (Warehouse) team / layer that loads data into the CIF database |
| ODS | Operational Data Store |
| DBACCOUNT.BOD_CA_CUST | CIF database table (cifdbv2) holding active contracts; carries `PARENT_LOAN_APPID` |
| crm.cstb_contact_app | iCollect database table where `ParentLoanAppID` is stored |
| ECM | Enterprise Content Management — document/image store (integration unchanged in this BRD) |
| ETL | Extract-Transform-Load batch job |
| CIF | Customer Information File |
